# Operational-risk scenario (`oprisk-scenario` v1)

A severe-but-plausible scenario with frequency and severity estimates.

**Group:** Operational and non-financial risk · **Mnemonic:** `OPSCN` · **Identifiers:** `OPSCN-…` in `scenarioId`

Open one with `OPSCN <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: oprisk-scenario
version: 1
description: A severe-but-plausible scenario with frequency and severity estimates.
match: { kind: oprisk-scenario, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Operational and non-financial risk · Operational-risk scenario, id: $.scenarioId }
strip:
  - { label: Scenario, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Event type, bind: $.eventType }
  - { label: Frequency (1 in N years), bind: $.returnPeriod, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Severity p50, bind: $.p50, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Severity p99.9, bind: $.p999, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: severity
    kind: hbar
    title: Severity by percentile
    key: F2
    rows: $.percentiles
    label: percentile
    value: loss
    fmt: compact
  - id: context
    kind: kv
    title: Context
    area: right
    rows: $.context
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
